health.cloud_readiness_note: credential presence (keys are unverified and no quota-consuming probes run) PLUS live circuit-breaker state: state/cooling_s/unverified_s/auth_error/last_error are measured from real traffic. last_error is the newest failure on any hop; auth_error and unverified_s appear only on a blocked provider and are the auth-class verdict standing on the credential and how long it has stood without being re-tested (a newer 429 or 5xx is not a re-check and does not retire the verdict — only a success does). last_error.detail is the provider's own response message, truncated to 300 chars and never request or prompt text; it is published only for automatic (cloud_fallback_chain) providers and is blank elsewhere
